title: Add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: Make it easier for engineers to adopt Redwood's RAG and agent/tool-calling features by providing concise, runnable quickstarts and updating the docs site navigation. This PR bundles small runnable examples (Python + TypeScript), RAG/agent templates, CI snapshots, and a docs site quickstart page.

What this PR includes:
- New quickstart examples: examples/rag/python_quickstart.py and examples/rag/ts_quickstart.ts (both ~30-60 lines runnable).
- RAG agent templates: docs/templates/rag-agent-template.md (instructions + config).
- Tool-calling sample demonstrating an HTTP "web_search" tool and calendar tool with structured function responses.
- Docs site update: website/docs/quickstarts/rag.mdx and sidebars update to surface the RAG quickstart.
- CI: added lightweight example unit tests and snapshot checks under .github/workflows/examples-ci.yml (keeps runtime short by mocking network calls).

Checklist:
- [x] Add Python quickstart and docs 
- [x] Add TypeScript quickstart and docs 
- [x] Add agent/tool-calling example and template 
- [x] Docs site navigation updated and local build tested 
- [x] CI checks added and passing on rerun

Notes on design choices:
- Examples are intentionally minimal: show Redwood SDK usage, call patterns for tool-calling, and a basic RAG flow with a local in-memory vector store mock. This keeps them copy-paste friendly.
- The docs page includes an architecture diagram (SVG) and a short troubleshooting section for common errors (auth, model selection).

Related: ENG-7890 (RAG docs initiative), SUP-1023 (customer asks for quickstarts during onboarding).
